messages:
sam: heads-up: deploy-bot raised an autopilot rollback suggestion for canary in us-west-2. seeing higher tail latency but errors are flat.
alex: do we have a change window? this is midday but traffic is light.
deploy-bot: Suggestion: Auto-rollback candidate for inference-canary v4.0.0. p99 latency up 3x vs baseline for 7m. Confidence: medium. Recommend action: automatic rollback in 5m, unless a human cancels.
paula: I'm in favor of human review. v4.0.0 rolled a couple of kernel optimizations; I want a quick perf check before flip.
ops_tony: agree. If we pause auto-rollback, we should run a controlled 15% split to stable v3.9.8 and validate.
pm_ryan: customer-facing note: if we roll back, we'll prepare a release note explaining perf regression and next steps. Legal wants <24h review but a simple blurb is fine.
sre-oncall: operational play: 1) cancel auto-rollback 2) split 15% -> v3.9.8 3) wait 10m 4) if p99 on slice <1.5x baseline, proceed to full rollback and pin. I'll monitor.
sam: cancelling autopilot now. command: 
```
deployctl autopilot cancel --service inference-canary --region us-west-2
```
deploy-bot: Autopilot canceled by @sam.
(30s)
sam: starting traffic split to v3.9.8 15%
```
deployctl traffic-split --service inference-canary --from v4.0.0 --to v3.9.8 --percent 15 --region us-west-2
```
deploy-bot: traffic-split complete. v3.9.8 serving 15% in us-west-2.
alex: slice p99 ~ 240ms, baseline 200ms. v4.0.0 slice still at 620ms.
paula: that delta is big. my vote: full rollback + pin.
ops_tony: before full: can we run a quick perf-run on identical instance type to confirm it's reproducible? takes ~3m.
sam: running perf-run job: 
```
perf-run --image v4.0.0 --type c5.4xlarge --duration 3m && perf-run --image v3.9.8 --type c5.4xlarge --duration 3m
```
deploy-bot: perf-run results: v4.0.0 p99 610ms, v3.9.8 p99 210ms.
pm_ryan: that's decisive. prepare customer blurb and we'll publish after rollback and pin. keep wording: "brief perf regression observed, rolled back to prior stable, investigating root cause".
sre-oncall: rolling back now. command: 
```
deployctl rollback --service inference-canary --to v3.9.8 --region us-west-2 --confirm
```
deploy-bot: Rollback in progress. progress updates enabled.
(90s)
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. v3.9.8 at 100% in us-west-2.
alex: p99 back to 200-230ms, error rate unchanged. good.
paula: pinning to prevent auto-rollforward while eng-runtime investigates: 
```
release pin inference-canary v3.9.8 --reason "post-release p99 regression" --owner @paula --until 2024-12-01
```
deploy-bot: Pin applied. Auto-rollforward disabled.
pm_ryan: draft customer note posted to #customer-comms-drafts. will coordinate legal sign-off.
ops_tony: created follow-up ticket ENG-5678 assigned to eng-runtime + perf. include perf-run logs and kernel diff.
sam: added a short retro: tighten autopilot threshold to avoid 5-10m noisy spikes, and require perf-run pass before auto-rollback for kernel changes.
paula: thanks all. closing thread after postmortem and customer note are merged. :white_check_mark:
